The '''Petranaki Arena execution cart''' was a [[repulsorlift]] vehicle that was manufactured by the [[Geonosian]]s and used as wagon to transport individuals to be [[Death|executed]] in the [[Petranaki Arena]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]].<ref name="Ships" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Appearances==
*{{Film|II}} {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''

==Behind the scenes==
The Petranaki Arena execution cart was first identified in "[[Miscellaneous Ships and Vehicles (2)]],"<ref name="Ships" /> a booklet in a series of reference booklets titled the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']], published by [[De Agostini]] on [[July 29]], [[2022]].<ref name="Altaya">{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref>
